support gates as frozen starting rules

forbidden_design_inputs: ANY T9 winner discovered in the parallel T9 research
natural_occurrence_rule: if a forbidden-list pattern occurs naturally in the complete frozen T3 grammar it is evaluated normally with every other eligible claim — it is never preferentially selected
no_narrative_rule: no hypothesis (absorption, reclaim, failed gap, volume expansion, breakout, oversold reversal, VA, VOL_W, BUY, L43) is privileged because the T3 candle visually suggests it; the full frozen grammar decides, and economic interpretation is POST-EXPOSURE only
forbidden_meaning: none of these may select, seed, weight or preferentially order any T3 hypothesis; the full grammar is enumerated and the data speaks
historical_cutoff_rule: the T3 max-null band MUST come from T9's own permutation distribution; neither T5's nor T9's band is ever reused
capability_rule: T5 capability does NOT qualify T3 — own population, support distribution, block geometry, k and null dependence
cross_family_selection: comparing T5 vs T3 and picking the better signal is a SEPARATE selection problem, logged separately when it happens

support_gates.revision_rule: never changed because the realized X distribution is inconvenient; an X-only feasibility problem STOPS the run and is documented as a pre-Y feasibility decision, not a preregistered gate

estimand.blocks: exact T3 date x pre-window liquidity LOW/HIGH x pre-window volatility LOW/HIGH, all pre-treatment
estimand.liquidity: 20-session median dollar volume ending T9-2, full pre-window required

inference.statistic: Z_rank (bounded blockwise MW/AUC, analytic tie-corrected null SE)
inference.theta_role: magnitude only; cannot rescue a Z_rank failure
